info.description: Restaurant/store app (enatega-multivendor-store). Auth via restaurantLogin (username = "FalafelTmeer@yopmail.com" / "Yalla0014yalla0014@"); returns an owner (VENDOR) token + restaurantId.

exec: try { const v = body.data.restaurantLogin.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') pm.collectionVariables.set('token', typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)); } catch (e) {}

try { const v = body.data.restaurantLogin.restaurantId; if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') pm.collectionVariables.set('restaurantId', typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)); } catch (e) {}
try { const v = body.data.profile._id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') pm.collectionVariables.set('ownerId', typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v)); } catch (e) {}
